title: Section aggregates: what is distinctive, rising, new and published in each section
description: For each section, from the Reference to section links: distinctive concepts (lift: share in the section against share in the site, with a support floor learned from the data), rising, newly seen, recently published about. Answers Ryan's question about filtering by section: this is not hard once References have sections, since a section's concepts are those its References and Stories mention. Written per section where packs can read it; private unless the public epic says otherwise.
